summary: Executed backend+frontend regression on preview URL for Google OAuth start flow, StoreHome route stability, admin live publish SLA, admin quick-find input, and profile link session behavior. Most requested flows passed; one critical backend CORS preflight failure persists.

critical.issue: Preflight from https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com still returns 400 instead of 200/204 with allow-origin + allow-credentials headers.

action_items: Fix backend CORS preflight handling for auth endpoints (allow OPTIONS + credentialed preview origin).
Re-run auth browser checks after CORS fix to confirm strict-browser compatibility.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS config likely causes 400 preflight because allow_methods excludes OPTIONS while credentialed auth requests require successful preflight.
server.py is large (>1300 lines); split auth/catalog/admin modules to reduce regression risk and speed RCA.
StoreHome guard changes appear effective in this run; prior undefined '.image' runtime error was not reproduced across requested navigation sequence.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for requested flows in this run

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST lockout customer via /api/auth/register for brute-force validation; created temporary TEST LIVE product for SLA check and then unpublished it via admin delete action.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google button redirected to accounts.google.com sign-in page and URL contained redirect_uri=https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com/auth/google; no redirect_uri_mismatch/400/403 text observed. Customer profile link opened /account with session intact. Admin quick-find input accepted typing on Products/Orders/Wallet/Banners/Coupons/Settings. Live publish appeared on a separate logged-in customer context without reload in ~0.10s. CORS preflight bug remains reproducible by direct OPTIONS.
rca of the issue: Auth preflight RCA: backend CORSMiddleware allow_methods is set to [GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE] and does not explicitly include OPTIONS, so browser preflight OPTIONS /api/auth/login returns 400 for preview-origin credentialed requests. Mitigation: include OPTIONS (or '*') in allow_methods and preserve explicit origin + allow_credentials=true; then verify with real browser preflight and pytest.
